projects.title: Stocktaker
projects.problem: Stock checks were done by hand on paper, then reconciled manually.
projects.metric: A stock-take went from roughly 10 people over a week to roughly 3 people in a day.
projects.description: Android app for physical stock checks: scan each item's barcode at a location and submit what was found to a shared master inventory Google Sheet.
howItWorks: Sign in with Google, pick a location, and the app loads that location's items from the master sheet.
Scan each barcode with the camera; items that belong to another location are flagged instead of being lost.
Submit writes what was found back to the master sheet, and unknown barcodes go to a separate tab.
Upload saves a CSV report of the check to a shared Drive folder.

projects.title: Linkbot
projects.description: Telegram bot that saves links shared from mobile (Instagram, TikTok, web articles), extracts structured details with an LLM, stores each one as a note in an Obsidian vault, and answers natural language questions about what's saved, re-ranking suggestions by live Singapore weather and air quality fetched from the government's data.gov.sg API.
howItWorks: Share a link to the bot from the phone's share sheet; the page is scraped to clean text (Jina Reader, Playwright for Instagram, yt-dlp for TikTok).
Gemini extracts structured fields such as name, type, address, hours, date, tags and setting (indoor, outdoor or both), and the bot shows them for review.
Reply ok to save, or type a correction and the bot merges it in before saving.
Each entry is saved as a markdown note with YAML frontmatter in the Obsidian vault.
Ask a question like "Japanese restaurants" and the bot answers from the saved notes.

For today or tonight, the bot fetches the 2-hour forecast and PSI from the government's data.gov.sg API (cached for 15 minutes, falling back to the last reading if the API is down), then moves outdoor places up when it's clear and indoor ones up when it's raining or hazy, with a wet-weather alternative for outdoor picks.

projects.title: Mahjong Score Calculator
projects.description: Website that calculates the tai of a Mahjong hand from the tiles you pick, checks whether the hand is a winning one, explains why not if it isn't, and suggests which tile to discard to get there. Rebuilt from the original in TypeScript.
howItWorks: Pick tiles from the selector; the tray arranges them by winning melds and supports drag-and-drop ordering.
Win detection uses recursive backtracking over sorted tiles for triplet and sequence melds, plus seven pairs and thirteen orphans.
Pinghu is detected automatically from the tile composition instead of a user checkbox.
Hand diagnostics explain why a hand is invalid and suggest the top discards ranked by number of valid draws.
